[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Greg and Array** [CF 295A · Greg and Array](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/295/A){rating="1400"}

A difference array is a difference array whether the axis holds array cells or *operation numbers*. Run the pattern twice: once on the timeline of operations to find out how many times each operation actually executes, then once on the array with each operation scaled by that count. The order of operations never matters because all of them only add.
